headline: Violent Exchanges Shake Stonecradle While Severe Attrition Grips Central Fronts
war_summary: Fresh territorial fighting has erupted in Stonecradle, where five base transfers unfolded over the last two hours amid rising enlistments and heavy casualties at World's End and The Dais. Mooring County also maintained high combat intensity with three recent base shifts around The Wind Hills, while tactical movement in Weathered Expanse subsided into sheer attrition, logging nearly 3,500 combined casualties across the two-hour window. The central theater in Dead Lands experienced a dramatic acceleration in violence, claiming over 3,500 casualties in two hours without direct base flips. Farther west, Nevish Line flared with a sharp surge in manpower and losses, registering over 1,200 casualties in the latest interval. Stlican Shelf continues to endure substantial crossfire with over 1,200 casualties in two hours, whereas Linn of Mercy has cooled significantly following earlier fierce contests. Meanwhile, sectors such as Callahan's Passage, Fisherman's Row, and Farranac Coast remain thoroughly subdued with minimal ground actions reported.
